input_oneliner: Cross-cover: 62F T2DM admitted w/ HF exacerbation, RUQ pain and vomiting x6h after dinner, T 38.4, HR 104

reference_targets_freetext.item: Murphy sign (inspiratory arrest on RUQ palpation)
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Best-studied bedside finding for acute cholecystitis, though less sensitive in elderly patients (Trowbridge 2003 RCE)
Jaundice with fever and RUQ pain points to cholangitis (Charcot triad)

reference_targets_freetext.item: Mental status check and blood pressure for Reynolds pentad
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Confusion or hypotension with cholangitis escalates to urgent biliary decompression

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask: prior biliary colic, known gallstones, and alcohol use
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Etiologic risk-factor history: prior colic and stones favor biliary disease; alcohol favors pancreatitis

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask: band-like pain radiating to the back
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Radiation to the back shifts probability toward pancreatitis

reference_targets_freetext.item: Peritoneal signs (rigidity, percussion tenderness, rebound, cough test)
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Screens for perforation of a peptic ulcer or gangrenous gallbladder

should_not_recommend: HIDA scan or CT before Murphy sign and jaundice assessment
Withholding analgesia to preserve the abdominal exam

perturbation_pair.changed_feature: no jaundice -> nurse reports new scleral icterus
perturbation_pair.input_oneliner: Cross-cover: 62F T2DM admitted w/ HF exacerbation, RUQ pain and vomiting x6h after dinner, T 38.4, HR 104, nurse notes new scleral icterus
perturbation_pair.expected_change: Cholangitis moves to the top; scleral icterus/jaundice stays must-have and the mental status and blood pressure check for Reynolds pentad becomes must-have; Murphy sign drops to should-still-include; ask about prior biliary stents or ERCP rises.

noise_variant.changed_feature: sign-out phrasing, family at bedside, and non-contributory detail
noise_variant.input_oneliner: Sixty-two year old woman, diabetic, in for heart failure flare, daughter at bedside, developed right upper belly pain with repeated vomiting about six hours ago after her evening meal, temp 38.4, pulse 104
noise_variant.expected_change: None. Card should be substantially identical to base.
